basic_profile.bio: A passionate Grey's Anatomy fan, I've been following the series since its inception. I reside in Seattle, fittingly, and work as a registered nurse, which gives me a unique perspective on the medical drama portrayed in the show. Outside of Reddit, I am avidly involved in local theater productions and enjoy hiking in the nearby Cascades. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after my shifts, around 7-10 PM PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in nursing, having graduated from the University of Washington. My expertise in medical procedures and patient care allows me to engage deeply with medical drama content. Additionally, my long-time fandom of Grey's Anatomy has made me a go-to person for discussions around the show's history and character development.
